name: Finding Love in the Lens
source:
You play as Jakob, who has an important connection to one of Luis' co-models... Follow along with him as a chance encounter becomes something so much more; anything from carnal passion to true love.

[From [url=https://jtommruh.itch.io/finding-love-in-the-lens]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演雅各布，他与路易斯的一位同事有着重要的联系……跟随他，一次偶然的邂逅变得意义非凡；从肉体的激情到真爱的任何事物。

[来自[url=https://jtommruh.itch.io/finding-love-in-the-lens]Itch.io[/url]]
